summary: Interactive venue floor plan with selectable rooms, stages, booths and services, multiple floors, a legend and details.
whenToUse: Helping attendees find rooms, sponsor booths, food and services.
Highlighting the rooms of a track or the room of the next session.
Venues on several floors with different areas per level.
whenNotToUse: Geographic location of the venue: use VenueMap.
Seat booking or maps with hundreds of elements: a dedicated component is needed.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the floor plan.

props.name: areas
props.description: Areas with id, label, kind, shape (rectangle or points) and optional level, capacity, isAccessible, isDisabled, description.

props.name: width / height
props.description: Size of the SVG coordinate system used by shape and markers.

props.name: outline
props.description: Building perimeter; by default a rectangle as large as the plan.

props.name: levels
props.description: Available floors; with more than one floor a switcher is shown. Areas without level belong to the first one.

props.name: level / defaultLevel / onLevelChange
props.description: Controlled and initial active floor, and its change callback.

props.name: selectedId / defaultSelectedId / onSelectionChange
props.description: Controlled and initial selected area, and its change callback.

props.name: highlightedIds
props.description: Areas highlighted with a dashed border, for example the rooms of a track.

props.name: markers
props.description: Points such as "You are here", with a brand or danger tone and an optional floor.

props.name: showLegend / showLabels
props.description: Show the legend of area kinds and the labels inside the areas.

props.name: renderDetails
props.description: Extra content in the details panel, for example the scheduled sessions.

keyboard.action: Enters the plan on the selected area or the first area (roving tabindex).
Move focus to the nearest area in the chosen direction.
Go to the first or last area of the floor.
Select the area and show its details.

accessibility: Each area is a button with name and kind, aria-pressed for selection and aria-disabled for closed areas.
Keyboard instructions are linked to the plan with aria-describedby.
The details panel is an aria-live region that announces the selected area.
The area kind is conveyed by text as well as color; in forced-colors mode areas use system colors.
After "Clear selection" focus returns to the area that was selected.
responsive: The SVG adapts to the container width while keeping its proportions.
From a 48rem container width the details sit next to the plan; below that they wrap underneath.
customization: Per-kind colors use the accent, action-primary and feedback-* tokens; redefine them in the theme.
Use renderDetails for schedules, speakers or booking links.
commonMistakes: Using pixel coordinates that do not match width/height: areas would be out of scale.
Very long labels in small areas: shorten them or set showLabels to false and rely on the legend.
Forgetting level on areas when passing levels.
limits: No zoom or pan: split very large plans into floors or zones.
Shapes are rectangles or polygons; curves and background images go in the outline or outside the component.
